# Claude limits fixtures

Real replies of Claude Code 2.1.316 to the `initialize` and `get_usage` control requests (one
`get_usage` with `skip_behaviors: true`, no prompt, no model call), trimmed to the keys the SDK
documents plus the undocumented `limits` and `spend`, which the reader must ignore. The email is a
placeholder; nothing else identifies an account. The `get_usage` shape is the same on 2.1.304.
